text:
sam: heads up — saw a billing spike for org 12345 after a streaming reconnect + toolcall retry. suspect double-charge
anya: can you paste the logs? this sounds like the partial-stream + fallback scenario
sam: logs snippet: ```
router: route=us-east-1 -> fallback=dedicated-b request_id=abc123 retry_id=abc123-1 tokens_charged=42
toolcall: start parent=abc123 tool=search tool_tokens=18 status=ok
stream: resumed parent=abc123 offset=1024 tokens=24
```
maria: ok, router is issuing a new request id on fallback, so billing service treats it as a separate session and charges both
leo: is this the provisional-charge flow? we bill on early tokens before final EOF reconciliation
anya: exactly — provisional charges occur at first write, and should be reconciled/credited when final outcome is received. problem is dedupe across fallback-created request ids
sam: side effect: console shows the provisional as real immediate cost, customers panic with a spike
maria: proposal A: propagate a stable parent_id / attestation token from router through retries/fallbacks to billing so we can dedupe on the back end
leo: proposal B: keep provisional billing but surface it as "pending" in the console UX and don't count against quota until finalization — needs quota gating changes
anya: telemetry idea: emit structured events: `charge.provisional`, `charge.final`, `stream.resume`, `toolcall.retry` all containing `parent_id` and `attestation_token` so we can stitch flows in logs and UI
sam: operationally we can also implement an 8s grace window where retries that share the parent_id are deduped before a final commit
maria: SQL for reconciliation debug: ```select parent_id, sum(tokens_charged) as provisional, sum(case when finalized then tokens_charged else 0 end) as final from charges where ts >= :t group by parent_id;``` helps find mismatches
leo: rollout plan: backend has a feature-flag `billing_attestation` default off. canary 1% -> 10% -> 100%. Console has `show_provisional_charges` toggled off for canary orgs to avoid alarming customers
sam: we also need tests: truncated toolcall + retry + early EOF to ensure credits apply and no double-bill
anya: add metric `billing.reconciled_rate` and alert if it falls below 95% over 24h post-deploy
maria: implementation notes: router must attach `X-Attest: <token>` to both fallback requests and toolcall sub-requests. billing service verifies token signature and uses it as dedupe key
leo: any objections? otherwise i'll start PRs for router + billing changes and a console flag for UX
deploy-bot: FYI scheduled deploy window: router/release-2026-03-22T02:00Z (maintenance)
sam: SGTM, i'll open the RFC and include telemetry schema + sample events
anya: SGTM. i'll add QA scenarios for reconnect, fallback, truncation, and toolcall retries
maria: ack — will add the reconciled_rate dashboard panels and an incident runbook for false-positive spikes
leo: thanks all, assigning tasks in the PR description and will link to the RFC when created
